title: Housewarming party
objectives: organize a gathering and offer drinks/food
use countable/uncountable nouns with polite offers

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Housewarming party.
Welcome to today's lesson: Housewarming party! Today we will practice how to organize a gathering and offer drinks/food.

elements.content: organize a gathering and offer drinks/food; use countable/uncountable nouns with polite offers

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: food, drink, water, tea, coffee, welcome

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What offer is polite when welcoming guests?

options: Would you like tea or coffee?
answers: Would you like tea or coffee?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Welcome to my new home! Come in, take a seat, and have some tea or juice.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Welcome guests to our housewarming party! We have food and drink. Would you like tea or coffee?
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Roleplay welcoming a guest to your home and offering food or beverages.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: organize a gathering and offer drinks/food, use countable/uncountable nouns with polite offers.
